segments.name: High-Touch Solutions N.A.
segments.description: Provides value-added MRO solutions rooted in deep product knowledge and customer expertise for customers with complex buying needs in North America.
segments.evidence: The Company's High-Touch Solutions N.A. segment provides value-added MRO solutions that are rooted in deep product knowledge and customer expertise.

segments.name: Endless Assortment
segments.description: Provides a streamlined and transparent online platform with one-stop shopping for millions of products, operating mainly in the U.S. and Japan.
segments.evidence: The Endless Assortment segment includes the Company's Zoro Tools, Inc. (Zoro) and MonotaRO Co., Ltd. (MonotaRO) online channels which operate predominately in the U.S. and Japan, respectively.

revenueModel.text: Grainger earns revenue by selling MRO products and related services, such as inventory management and technical support, to businesses, government entities and institutions through both high-touch and online channels.
revenueModel.evidence: Grainger's customers range from smaller businesses to large corporations, government entities and other institutions, representing a broad collection of industries, including, but not limited to commercial, healthcare, and manufacturing.

changes.text: In 2025, Grainger exited the U.K. market, completing the sale of the Cromwell business and closing the Zoro U.K. business.
changes.evidence: In the fourth quarter of 2025, Grainger exited the U.K. market by completing the sale of the Cromwell business and closing the Zoro U.K. business.
